project.name: Cần & Có - AI Real Estate Super App
project.status: Phase 03: API Rewrite (Supabase → Prisma) — 62.5% done (31 files)

backend.database: PostgreSQL via Prisma 7 ORM (Driver Adapter + pg Pool)
backend.storage: Supabase Storage (images — to be migrated to S3/R2)

database_schema.summary: 25+ tables: Users, Profiles, Bots, Intents (CẦN/CÓ), Posts, Comments, Matches, Notifications, Crawler pipeline, Content moderation, Gamification
key_models: Post + Comment + Like + Save — Social feed
database_schema.relationships_explained: Bot lấy RawNews → tạo Intent. User tạo Intent CẦN/CÓ. Matching engine tìm CẦN↔CÓ pairs. Bot comments on intents via orchestrator.

api_endpoints.explained: Feed bài viết social (posts) — GET with pagination
CẦN/CÓ intents — GET (list+filter) & POST (create with AI parsing)
Intent detail — GET/PUT/DELETE with ownership check
AI parse raw text into tags (no DB write)
Batch URL health check for crawled intents
Trigger matching pipeline for an intent
Bot CRUD — GET list, POST create, PUT update
User gamification stats (points, level, streak, rank)
User achievement progress and unlocked badges
Batch assign bot avatars by handle/keyword

business_rules: Intent types: CẦN (seeking) and CÓ (offering) — matched by district, price, bedrooms
Bot personas: match_advisor, nha_advisor, trust_checker, concierge, connector, market_analyst
Bot anti-spam: max 3 bots comment per intent, match_advisor always first
Content moderation: AI + keyword check, 3 violations = permanent ban
Trust scoring: verified > kyc > none, affects match ranking
BigInt price fields in DB, converted to Number for JSON responses
features: Super App multi-tab layout (Feed, Map, Khớp Nhanh, Chat, Mini-Apps)
CẦN & CÓ Intent Marketplace with AI matching engine
AI Bot Network (Broker Bots with geographic jurisdictions)
Real-time market analytics (Brain AI Analytics panel)
Admin Dashboard (HR, Crawl Sources, Bot Operations)
NextAuth credential-based auth (migrated from Supabase Auth)

patterns: requireAuth(request) → { userId } | { error: Response } pattern for API routes
toSnakeCase() for Prisma camelCase → frontend snake_case conversion
toIntentType() for Prisma result → Intent type mapping in matching engine
BigInt price → Number() for JSON serialization across all intent responses
Manual snake_case mapping for complex nested responses (intents GET)
Dynamic snake→camel key mapping for generic PUT endpoints (bots)
Prisma atomic increment/decrement replaces Supabase RPC functions
gotchas: Supabase pooler (6543) chặn Schema Metadata introspection
Prisma 7.x requires prisma.config.ts instead of url in schema.prisma
pgvector Unsupported('vector(1536)') must be removed from schema, use $executeRaw
middleware.ts blocks ALL /api/ routes without JWT — test APIs via browser not fetch
BigInt cannot be JSON.stringify'd — must convert price/priceMin/priceMax to Number()
Supabase Storage still needed for image uploads until S3/R2 migration
Gamification libs partially migrated (leaderboard+achievements done, streaks/reactions/predictions/points pending)
conventions: API responses must maintain snake_case field names for frontend compatibility
Auth-required routes use requireAuth(), public GETs use getAuthUserId() for optional auth
Atomic counter updates (increment/decrement) instead of read-then-update pattern
